### The Courses

[IMD](https://bit.ly/49KkYgK) offers programs for individuals and teams - including Degrees, Open Programs, Executive Certificates and Diplomas - as well as tailored solutions for organizations designed to address their unique challenges and drive lasting impact.

### The Business School

### The Courses

![](https://executivecourses.com/media/cache/w400/uploads/media/sponsor/0001/01/classroom-ce42b.jpg)

[Michigan Ross Executive Education](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/michigan-ross-school-of-business-executive-education?utm_source=executive-courses&utm_medium=paid-profile&utm_campaign=ee-linkedin&utm_term=executive+education&utm_content=ee-linkedin) offers open enrollment and custom programs that [develop individuals](https://michiganross.umich.edu/programs/executive-education/programs-for-individuals?utm_source=executive-courses&utm_medium=paid-profile&utm_campaign=programs-for-individuals&utm_term=executive+education&utm_content=programs-for-individuals), strengthen teams, and create lasting impact for [organizations](https://michiganross.umich.edu/programs/executive-education/custom-programs?utm_source=executive-courses&utm_medium=paid-profile&utm_campaign=custom-programs&utm_term=executive+education&utm_content=custom-programs). Built on a pioneering approach to action-based learning, programs combine innovative research with practical application to address real-world business challenges.

From focused learning experiences to comprehensive executive development, programs support leaders as they take on greater responsibility and organizations as they navigate growth and change.

### The Business School

![](https://executivecourses.com/media/cache/w400/uploads/media/sponsor/0001/01/building-4283e.jpg)

The Stephen M. Ross School of Business at the University of Michigan is a diverse learning community grounded in the principle that business can be an extraordinary vehicle for positive change. Guided by its mission of building a better world through business, Michigan Ross is consistently ranked among the world's leading business schools.

Building on that foundation, [Michigan Ross Executive Education](https://michiganross.umich.edu/programs/executive-education?utm_source=executive-courses&utm_medium=paid-profile&utm_campaign=ee&utm_term=executive+education&utm_content=ee) partners with individuals and organizations around the world to develop leaders, strengthen organizations, and solve complex business challenges through research-driven, action-based learning experiences.

### The Faculty

![](https://executivecourses.com/media/cache/w400/uploads/media/sponsor/0001/01/light-studio-0882c.jpg)

Michigan Ross Executive Education faculty are internationally recognized scholars whose work has influenced business practice around the world. As the same faculty who teach in the school's highly ranked degree programs, they bring the latest evidence-based [insights](https://michiganross.umich.edu/programs/executive-education/insights?utm_source=executive-courses&utm_medium=paid-profile&utm_campaign=ee-insights&utm_term=executive+education&utm_content=ee-insights) to global executives, translating research into practical application. Their expertise is regularly featured in The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Forbes, and other leading publications.

Programs are further enriched through collaborations with faculty from across the University of Michigan and select industry experts, reflecting the interdisciplinary nature of today's business landscape.

### The Business School

At [Berkeley Executive Education](https://executive.berkeley.edu/?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral), we help people discover their full potential and reimagine their future through transformational educational experiences. We offer a variety of short-form and intensive learning opportunities for individuals, [groups of colleagues](https://executive.berkeley.edu/group-enrollment?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral), or organizations. Topics include [Leadership & Communication](https://executive.berkeley.edu/leadership-communications-programs?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral), [Strategy & Management](https://executive.berkeley.edu/strategy-management?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral), [Entrepreneurship & Innovation](https://executive.berkeley.edu/entrepreneurship-innovation-programs?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral), and [Finance & Business Acumen](https://executive.berkeley.edu/finance-business-acumen-programs?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral). Taught by [world-renowned faculty](https://executive.berkeley.edu/faculty-directory?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral) from the Berkeley Haas School of Business, our programs combine a research-driven curriculum with industry best practices.

### The Faculty

Berkeley Executive Education programs are taught by preeminent [professors and faculty](https://executive.berkeley.edu/faculty-directory?utm_source=exec_courses&utm_medium=referral) from UC Berkeley and the Haas School of Business. A total of 21 faculty have been named Nobel Prize winners and 4 Pulitzer Prize winners.
